Hi Anna - thanks for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our call:

- Goal: Integrate Redwood's marketplace connector so CloudBridge can onboard models to the GSI marketplace and enable their customers to provision dedicated inference.
- Key technical items we heard: model packaging requirements, auth/KMS expectations, and deployment pattern (edge vs. centralized).
- Success criteria for the technical deep dive: validate ingestion flow, confirm auth handoff, and map out telemetry and alerting needs.

Proposed next meeting: technical deep dive (60 min) focused on engineering/infra + marketplace onboarding. Our team availability (PT):
- Tue 10/6 09:00 - 11:30
- Tue 10/6 14:00 - 16:00
- Wed 10/7 10:00 - 12:00

I've attached a short mutual action plan and the marketplace ingestion spec for context. Can you confirm which slot works for CloudBridge and whether we should loop in your GSI partner (Raj) for the deep dive?

Thanks - looking forward to aligning calendars.

Best,
Marissa Cole

+1 (415) 555-0123
